rca of the issue: Root cause: frontend/src/pages/JobMap.jsx handleUndergroundDragEnd (L591-608) targeted `/jobs/${jobId}/underground/${ugId}` which does not exist on the backend router (/app/backend/routes/underground.py exposes PUT /underground/{item_id} at L40 only). FastAPI returned 404, axios threw, then catch triggered fetchData() reverting the optimistic UI update — making the marker appear un-draggable. Mitigation applied: changed axios.put URL from `/jobs/${jobId}/underground/${ugId}` to `/underground/${ugId}` so the request matches the backend contract. Verified via live drag: PUT 200 + DB row updated + subsequent reload preserves new coords. Reproduction (now resolved): open /jobs/{id}/map -> Edit Map -> Move Items -> drag any green square (HH/HB) marker -> observe network 200 and no revert.
